description: Because of my schedule, I have decided that sending out newsletters every other week is a lot more predictable. From now on, plan on seeing these every other Thursday. Last week, four of my bills have moved further along the process. If you have any ideas you want me to hear, or need help navigating state resources, please contact my office: E: Chad.Clifford.House@coleg.gov P: 303-866-5510 Legislative updates on the bills I'm sponsoring HB25-1017 – Community Integration Plan for Individuals with Disabilities has passed the House Health and Human Services Committee unanimously and is now headed to the House Appropriations Committee. This bill ensures that Coloradans with disabilities have access to live and receive treatment in integrated community settings when appropriate for their needs, rather than being institutionalized. Check out CBS News Colorado's article on this bill here.
title: HD-37 Newsletter
